emotional_tone: Warm, elegant, vibrant, authentic West African hospitality

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl+ font-bold tracking-tighter leading-none font-serif
rules.overline: uppercase text-xs tracking-[0.2em] font-sans font-semibold text-primary

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' GRID (Asymmetrical bento-style for gallery)

hero.strategy: Since one perfect image with all elements isn't available, use a dynamic Bento Hero layout or a split screen where the golden pastries (donuts/mikatés) and the ruby red drink (bissap) are beautifully juxtaposed. Overlay subtle gradients if text is on top.

components.navbar: Glassmorphism navigation. 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70' with delicate border underneath. Floating effect. Logo in serif font.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. 'The Editorial Ribbon' style: Pale sand background, dark earthy text, serif font, huge gaps between words ('Saveurs Authentiques • Pâtisserie de Luxe • Street-food Vibrant').
components.product_cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border '#E8E2D9'. No shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and soft shadow. Use arched top images (rounded-t-full) to add organic African elegance.
components.photo_gallery: Tetris grid. Grid of images with no spacing (gap-0) or large spacing (gap-6) depending on tension desired. Mix spanning rules (col-span-1, col-span-2). Hover effect: subtle scale (scale-105) with overflow-hidden wrapper.
components.testimonial_carousel: Clean minimalist cards on a slightly contrasting background section. Italic serif text for the quote. Circular avatar images.
components.order_form: Shadcn based. Heavily customized with warm borders, rounded-xl inputs. Focus rings in primary Ruby Red.
components.whatsapp_button: Fixed at bottom-right (z-50). Green background (#25D366) with WhatsApp icon (Lucide or react-icons). Pulse animation on hover.
components.footer: Dark background (#1D1914). Massive typographic CTA 'Envie de douceur ?'. Links to social media. Text color warm sand.

interactions.hover_states: All buttons must change to a lighter/darker hue. Text color explicitly set on hover.
interactions.animations: Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals (fade up). Staggered entrance for product cards and gallery.

testing.required_attributes: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements. Example: 'order-form-submit-button', 'whatsapp-float-btn', 'product-order-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit'.
Install 'lucide-react' (if not already present) or 'react-icons' for the WhatsApp and social icons.
Install 'framer-motion' for scroll animations and 'react-fast-marquee' for the editorial ribbon.
Apply generous padding to sections (py-24 or py-32).
DO NOT use generic center alignment everywhere. Use optical alignment and asymmetric bento grids for the gallery.

For the hero section, since one single image doesn't combine mikatés, bissap and tropical juice perfectly, design a split-screen or 3-column bento hero displaying the pastries, the red drink, and the tropical vibes side-by-side beautifully.
The primary CTA buttons should use the ruby red color (#9A1F38) to stand out against the warm sand backgrounds.
Write the code in Javascript (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript.
